title: fix(spec)!: the datasource read redactor covers the declared ssl secret members
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XEu7gE4oELHqp9KjL2Q94sX)_

Fixes #28633

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` or `content/docs` states what a metadata read serves of a datasource's `ssl` block; the TLS bullet in `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx` stays true as written.

**BREAKING** read-answer narrowing (`@objectstack/spec`, shipped as `patch`): the metadata read exits no longer serve a datasource's `ssl.key`. No authored value is refused and no stored row is rewritten.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：数据源的元数据读出口现在连同 `ssl` 块里声明的密钥成员（`ssl.key`）一起脱敏，做法与 `config` 里的凭据一致：不下发，并在 `redactedKeys` 里点名 `ssl.key`。
- **为什么改**：`DatasourceSchema` 的 `ssl.key` 是客户端私钥，让它和 `config` 凭据走同一条声明式脱敏规则。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只让读出口少下发一个字段；存储行不改写，保存时原样带回已存的 key；`ca`/`cert`/`enabled`/`rejectUnauthorized` 照常下发。回滚即撤掉 schema 上的 `credential` 标记与脱敏器里那一段。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-redaction.ts`（`redactDatasourceItem` 新增的标记字段一段）；`packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts`（`ssl.key` 的 `credential` 标记）；`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-credential-fields.test.ts`（守卫多读两个词）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/kernel/metadata-type-redaction.test.ts`，预期全部通过（main 上新增的 4 条为红）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The datasource read redactor covers the declared `ssl` secret members.

- `packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts`: `DatasourceSchema.ssl.key` (the client private key) is marked `.meta({ credential: 'value' })`, the schema-declared credential marker from ruling B+ on #24966 (`kernel/metadata-credential-fields.ts`). It is the only secret member of the declared `ssl` block (`enabled`, `rejectUnauthorized`, `ca`, `cert`, `key`); `ca` and `cert` are public material and are not marked. The block declares no `passphrase`.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-redaction.ts`: `redactDatasourceItem` keeps its `config` half (`redactDatasourceConfig`, unchanged) and adds a second half that applies the credential markers on the registered `datasource` schema, through the same derivation the third resolution uses (`derivedCredentialRedactorFor`). The built-in wins the lookup over the derivation, so without this half a marker on `DatasourceSchema` was never read. The result names `ssl.key` in `redactedKeys` in the same dotted shape as `config.password`, sorted together with the `config` paths. An item with nothing to withhold is still returned by reference.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-credential-fields.test.ts`: the credential-field ratchet's description rule also reads `private key` and `passphrase`. With it, an unmarked `ssl.key` reds the ratchet (`datasource:ssl.key`), so the marker cannot be dropped silently.
- Tests (below) and `.changeset/28633-datasource-ssl-key-redaction.md` (`@objectstack/spec` patch).

**Why the marker, not a second hand list.** The order prefers deriving the set from schema credential markers where the module supports it, and it does: the marker is the one declaration, the derivation already exists, and the ratchet beside it now catches a forgotten one. The `config` rule in `data/datasource-credential-redaction.ts` stays the home of driver-config credentials (derived from each driver's `z.never()` contract); `ssl` is not a driver-config member, so it is not added there.

**Consumers inherit it.** Every read exit resolves the `datasource` redactor through `getMetadataTypeRedactor`, so none needed a code change. Measured and pinned:

| Read exit | Resolves through | Pinned in |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `/meta` list, item, layered (`getMetaItems`, `getMetaItem`, `getMetaItemLayered`) | `redactMetadataItem` → registry | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.metadata-redaction.test.ts` |
| `sys_metadata` / `sys_metadata_history` through the data API (`findData`, `getData`) | metadata-protocol `redactStoredMetadataRow` → registry | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.data-door-stored-metadata-redaction.test.ts` |
| a code-registered datasource served by the metadata service (`getPublished`) | `MetadataManager.redactServedBody` → registry | `packages/metadata/src/metadata-service.test.ts` |
| the spec stored-row and stored-body seams (`redactStoredMetadataRow` / `redactStoredMetadataBody`: the MCP stdio data bridge, the audit writer, the automation CRUD nodes) | registry | `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-redaction.test.ts` |

**Write path.** The generic carry-forward (`carryForwardRedactedValues`) walks `redactedKeys`, so a save that sends back the served body keeps the stored `ssl.key`; pinned by a GET, edit, PUT round trip.

## Tests

New and extended cases, all in existing files:

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-redaction.test.ts`, new block (6 cases): `ssl.key` dropped and named while `enabled` / `rejectUnauthorized` / `ca` / `cert` stay; withheld with no `config` object at all; `config.password` and `ssl.key` together in one sorted `redactedKeys`; the stored-row seam on a serialized body. Controls: no `ssl` block, and an `ssl` block with no `key`, are returned by reference with `redactedKeys: []`; the cleared form (`key: ''`) is served as written. The existing `config` cases are unchanged and green.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.metadata-redaction.test.ts` (3 cases): `getMetaItems`, `getMetaItem`, `getMetaItemLayered` (overlay and effective) serve `ssl` without `key` and the stored row keeps it; control with no key; GET, edit, PUT keeps the stored key.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.data-door-stored-metadata-redaction.test.ts` (3 cases): `findData` and `getData` on `sys_metadata`, a `sys_metadata_history` snapshot; control body served as its stored bytes.
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-service.test.ts` (1 case): a code-registered datasource through `getPublished`, with the real built-in redactor.

<details><summary>Red first, green, ablation</summary>

- **Red first** (`origin/main` sources, new spec cases in place): `src/kernel/metadata-type-redaction.test.ts` gave `Tests 4 failed | 35 passed (39)`; the four red cases are the withholding cases, the controls passed.
- **Green** at head: the same file and `metadata-credential-fields.test.ts` plus `src/data/`: `Test Files 155 passed (155)`, `Tests 4748 passed | 1 todo`.
- **Ablation** with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (each restore `blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - A1, the marked-fields half of `redactDatasourceItem` removed: `Tests 4 failed | 44 passed (48)` over the redaction and ratchet files; the four withholding cases red, controls green.
  - A2, the `credential` marker removed from `ssl.key`: `Tests 5 failed | 43 passed (48)`: the four withholding cases and the ratchet (`expected [ 'datasource:ssl.key' ] to deeply equal []`).
  - A3, the marker removed with the ratchet's description rule held at its `origin/main` text: ratchet `Tests 9 passed (9)`, which is why the rule gains `private key` / `passphrase`.
  - A4, consumers through the built `dist/`: the A1 mutation spelled `(globalThis as any).ABLATION_28633`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` (dist reading passed), then metadata-protocol `Tests 4 failed | 66 passed (70)` (every new withholding case) and metadata `1 failed` (the new case). Restore leg rebuilt spec; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs ... --absent` exit 0, dist and tree both clean.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `ssl.key` is documented as "PEM format or path to file". A path is not secret, but the redactor cannot tell the two forms apart, so both are withheld. Withholding a path costs a reader nothing it can act on through the read door, and the stored row keeps it for the connect path.
- The datasource admin door's own read (PR #28648) withholds a stored key separately; this PR does not touch `packages/services/service-datasource`.

## Verification

All readings on head `a2d8e887` (two commits on `origin/main` `6b9c1ca9`; the diff is the eight files above).

- **Consumer suites** (`pnpm --filter PKG test`, under the lock, after building their closures): `@objectstack/spec` 782 files / 23128 tests passed; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 291 passed, 4 skipped / 21950 passed; `@objectstack/metadata` 65 / 919; `@objectstack/rest` 363 / 6910 (332 skipped); `@objectstack/runtime` 503 / 8171 (19 skipped); `@objectstack/service-datasource` 67 / 1125; `@objectstack/mcp` 48 / 612; `@objectstack/plugin-audit` 68 / 1109; `@objectstack/service-automation` 251 / 3185. All exit 0. These are every package outside spec that imports `getMetadataTypeRedactor` or a stored-body seam (`redactStoredMetadataBody`, `redactStoredMetadataRow(s)`, `redactMetadataItem`).
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` + `@objectstack/metadata` typecheck exit 0.
- **Derived gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 80 families, each run with its exit captured before any pipe and stdin from `/dev/null`: 80 × exit 0. Two needed a prerequisite first: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` answered exit 3 on the shallow clone and exit 0 after `git fetch --depth=1` of its fixture commit; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3) before a full build and exit 0 after `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (115 entry points across 70 packages load). `--ran`: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 80 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 80 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. No generated artifact moved (`check:docs`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:api-surface` exit 0, tree clean).
- **Hand gates:** `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0; `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` exit 0 (1 anchored file, 2 anchors judged, 0 lost); `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed `.ts` files exit 0; control-byte scan of the changed files: no hits. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **Full dogfood** (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm), after the full build, under the lock, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` → `Test Files 369 passed | 3 skipped (372)`, `Tests 2981 passed | 28 skipped (3009)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **CI** families (Test Core incl. `test:repo`, the lint farm, the type-check lanes) are read off this PR's check-runs by the seat.
